query: MATCH (p:Process)-[:IsProcessOf]->(m:Model), (per:PhysicalEntityRepresentation)-[:Modifier]->(p) WHERE p.name CONTAINS 'transcription' RETURN per.name
MATCH (c:PhysicalCompartment)<-[:ContainedEntity]-(e:PhysicalEntityRepresentation) RETURN c.name AS Compartment, collect(e.name) AS Species
MATCH (p:PhysicalEntityRepresentation {name: 'LacI'})-[r]-(proc:Process) RETURN p.name AS entity, type(r) AS role, proc.name AS process
MATCH (r:PhysicalEntityRepresentation)-[:Modifier]->(p:Process)-[:Product]->(prod:PhysicalEntityRepresentation) WHERE prod.name = "TetR mRNA" RETURN r.name AS Regulator

MATCH (p:PhysicalEntityRepresentation)-[:ContainedEntity]->(c:PhysicalCompartment {name: 'cell'}) MATCH (p)-[:Reactant|Modifier|Product]-(:Process) WHERE p.isInstanceOf IN ['protein', 'mRNA'] RETURN DISTINCT p.name, p.isInstanceOf

MATCH (m:Model) OPTIONAL MATCH (entity:PhysicalEntityRepresentation)-[:IsEntityOf]->(m) OPTIONAL MATCH (process:Process)-[:IsProcessOf]->(m) RETURN m.name AS model, count(DISTINCT entity) AS speciesCount, count(DISTINCT process) AS reactionCount

MATCH (p:PhysicalEntityRepresentation) OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:Reactant]->(proc1:Process) OPTIONAL MATCH (proc2:Process)-[:Product]->(p) OPTIONAL MATCH (p)-[:Modifier]->(proc3:Process) WITH p, count(DISTINCT proc1) + count(DISTINCT proc2) + count(DISTINCT proc3) AS totalReactions RETURN p.name AS species, totalReactions ORDER BY totalReactions DESC LIMIT 10
